# United Press Media (UPM)

> UPM is a digital marketing agency offering press release distribution, tier-1 media placements, KOL collaborations, sponsored content, and vibe coding (rapid MVP development).

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of UPM's growth platform for digital marketing.
- [Services](/services): KOL collaborations, press releases, tier-1 media, paid ads.
- [Media for Brands](/media-for-brands): Earned media and PR for Web3 and tech brands.
- [Alchemist Reach](/alchemist-reach): The outreach tool inside Fullmedia Alchemist (https://www.fullmediaalchemist.com/reach-features/) — ask for a shortlist of creators and outlets, draft, confirm, track replies and log rates. Run it yourself on a free-to-start plan, or have UPM run it for you on Silver or Gold.
- [Creators](/creators): Programs and platform for content creators and KOLs.
- [Vibe Coding](/vibe-coding): Rapid MVP and app development services.
- [Compromised Wallet Rescue](/wallet-rescue): Introductions to white-hat specialists for wallets with exposed keys and funds not yet drained.
- [Apps We've Built](/our-products): UPM's portfolio of apps including Fullmedia Alchemist (https://www.fullmediaalchemist.com/), Reading Race, SpinQuest, Watch Crypto, Vaporsmooth, AmplifyHub, Re-Writeable AI, and Everything Nightlife (https://everythingnightlife.com).
- [Case Studies](/case-studies): Client results and campaign breakdowns.
- [Trending News](/trending): Curated top stories in tech, AI, crypto, and gaming.
- [Think Tank](/think-tank): Research and strategy insights.
- [Blog](/blog): UPM news and insights — tech, AI, crypto, gaming.
- [About](/about): About United Press Media.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch with the UPM team.
- [Help Center](/help-center): Support and FAQs.
